psychological_meaning: Venus is a muted, dusky purple-gray, often associated with sophistication and understated elegance. It evokes a sense of calm and maturity, suggesting a blend of creativity and practicality. This color can represent introspection and a thoughtful approach to life, while also hinting at a touch of mystery and allure.
